newsitem.title: USA: Duke 1,129 MW Catawba nuke at full power.
newsitem.headline: Duke 1,129 MW Catawba nuke at full power.

text.p: Duke Power Co's 1,129 megawatt Catawba nuclear power unit 1 was operating at full output as of early Wednesday, fully returning from a repair outage, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.

Both the Catawba units, located in Clover, S.C., and each with a capacity of 1,129 megawatts, were operating at 100 percent of output as of early Wednesday, the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
Catawba unit 1 was shut late Thursday due to a leak in a reactor coolant pump, and resumed power output over the weekend.
